description: A $2,500 award for a sophomore or junior in a STEM major who holds an active AFCEA student or Junior Enlisted membership.
eligibility_text: Must be an undergraduate student enrolled full-time at a four-year accredited U.S. college; online degree programs are eligible. Must be a sophomore or junior at the time of application. Must have a minimum overall GPA of 3.0 in their current academic program. Must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Students attending a community college, freshmen and seniors are not eligible. Must also hold an active AFCEA membership - either a student membership or a Junior Enlisted membership.
notes: Split out of the retired 'afcea-stem-scholarship' umbrella on 2026-09-19. The umbrella averaged 13 named awards into eligibility true of none of them. This is the named 'Student Member Scholarship ($2,500)' on the STEM Majors page. The AFCEA membership requirement is the only thing separating it from the STEM Major award, and the umbrella recorded no membership requirement at all.
